city.name: Stillwater
city.description: A small post-industrial river city of about 40,000, one plant away from quiet decline.

districts.name: Council Quarter
districts.description: Civic core around the council tower; courts, police, municipal offices.

districts.name: Market Row
districts.description: Shops, the transit interchange and the old Carnegie library.

districts.name: Larkfield
districts.description: Terraced streets, the primary school and Orchard Tower.

districts.name: Mill District
districts.description: Halvorsen Components and the sheds that feed it.

districts.name: The Flats
districts.description: River embankment, the underpass and St Brennan's shelter.

districts.name: Hollins Edge
districts.description: Detached houses and the park at the city's edge.

residents.name: Daniel Okafor
residents.citizen_bio: Daniel has kept Line 3 running for twelve years and still coaches Saturday football.

residents.name: Grace Okafor
residents.citizen_bio: Grace knows every child at Larkfield Primary by name, and most of their grandparents.

residents.name: Tobi Okafor
residents.citizen_bio: Tobi is saving for his first car and DJs at the Market Hall youth night.

residents.name: Marguerite Hale
residents.citizen_bio: Marguerite worked the Halvorsen lathes for forty years and still bakes for the whole floor.

residents.name: Ray Dunmore
residents.citizen_bio: Ray can fix any bicycle you bring to the riverside, usually for free.

residents.name: Lena Voss
residents.citizen_bio: Lena sketches the river at dawn; a few of her drawings hang in the shelter hallway.

residents.name: Sami Haddad
residents.household: Partner r12; renting a flat above Market Row
residents.citizen_bio: Sami knows every shortcut in Stillwater and the name of every dog on his route.

residents.name: Ines Carvalho
residents.citizen_bio: Ines runs the library's local history archive and the Thursday chess club.

residents.name: Kyle Brandt
residents.household: Rents a room in the Mill District
residents.citizen_bio: Kyle is back on his feet and looking for work; he's handy with engines.

residents.name: Frank Mercer
residents.citizen_bio: Frank has lived in Orchard Tower longer than anyone and keeps the lobby plants alive.

residents.name: Priya Natarajan
residents.citizen_bio: Priya chairs the Stillwater Business Forum and runs the park 5k every spring.

residents.name: Joan Pell
residents.citizen_bio: Joan has worked the walk-in clinic's night shift for six years and never misses a pub quiz.

disruptions.description: Halvorsen Components announces Line 3 consolidation: 140 roles at risk.

city.name: Stillwater
city.description: A small post-industrial river city of about 40,000, one plant away from quiet decline.

districts.name: Council Quarter
districts.description: Civic core around the council tower; courts, police, municipal offices.

districts.name: Market Row
districts.description: Shops, the transit interchange and the old Carnegie library.

districts.name: Larkfield
districts.description: Terraced streets, the primary school and Orchard Tower.

districts.name: Mill District
districts.description: Halvorsen Components and the sheds that feed it.

districts.name: The Flats
districts.description: River embankment, the underpass and St Brennan's shelter.

districts.name: Hollins Edge
districts.description: Detached houses and the park at the city's edge.

residents.name: Daniel Okafor
residents.citizen_bio: Daniel has kept Line 3 running for twelve years and still coaches Saturday football.

residents.name: Grace Okafor
residents.citizen_bio: Grace knows every child at Larkfield Primary by name, and most of their grandparents.

residents.name: Tobi Okafor
residents.citizen_bio: Tobi is saving for his first car and DJs at the Market Hall youth night.

residents.name: Marguerite Hale
residents.citizen_bio: Marguerite worked the Halvorsen lathes for forty years and still bakes for the whole floor.

residents.name: Ray Dunmore
residents.citizen_bio: Ray can fix any bicycle you bring to the riverside, usually for free.

residents.name: Lena Voss
residents.citizen_bio: Lena sketches the river at dawn; a few of her drawings hang in the shelter hallway.

residents.name: Sami Haddad
residents.household: Partner r12; renting a flat above Market Row
residents.citizen_bio: Sami knows every shortcut in Stillwater and the name of every dog on his route.

residents.name: Ines Carvalho
residents.citizen_bio: Ines runs the library's local history archive and the Thursday chess club.

residents.name: Kyle Brandt
residents.household: Rents a room in the Mill District
residents.citizen_bio: Kyle is back on his feet and looking for work; he's handy with engines.

residents.name: Frank Mercer
residents.citizen_bio: Frank has lived in Orchard Tower longer than anyone and keeps the lobby plants alive.

residents.name: Priya Natarajan
residents.citizen_bio: Priya chairs the Stillwater Business Forum and runs the park 5k every spring.

residents.name: Joan Pell
residents.citizen_bio: Joan has worked the walk-in clinic's night shift for six years and never misses a pub quiz.
